name: What should I look for when hiring an exterior painting contractor?

mainEntity.name: What should I look for when hiring an exterior painting contractor?

acceptedAnswer.text: When hiring an exterior painting contractor, look for experience, proper licensing and insurance, and a strong portfolio of past work. Reputable contractors should provide a detailed, written estimate that outlines all costs, materials, and the scope of work. Check for positive customer reviews and references to gauge their reliability and quality of service. A good contractor will also communicate clearly, answer your questions thoroughly, and stand behind their work with a warranty. We are licensed, insured, and committed to transparency.
acceptedAnswer.description: Look for licensed, insured, and experienced contractors with good references, detailed estimates, and warranties when hiring for exterior painting.
